null_population.description: Same algorithm/field/target/seed in fresh process; the same AA panel supplies nuisance null, not a separate independent sample.
null_population.generator: New exec per arm, fixed source/config/target/budgets.
null_population.why_n: Qualification or separate calibration only; no population significance or winner inference.

factors.name: representation_field_and_m
factors.how: Keep configurations separate. Rational fixtures are Mobius conjugates of squaring, not auxiliary-isogeny search benchmarks. Word62 has no prime-order subgroup assertion; P224 standard curve.

factors.name: target_population
factors.how: Alternating inputs, same exact target across all arms; identity separate.

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: One immutable native release binary, locked dependencies, one CPU.

factors.name: arm_order
factors.value: cyclic9 by input, first positive first
factors.how: Only qualification/calibration; no primary order or significance claim.

factors.name: host_environment
factors.how: Unmodified isolated_bench CPU4; missing PSI/unmovable host threads mean below-L2 clocks.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Raw per-input values/ranges retained; no statistical significance test.

factors.name: construction_backend
factors.value: KaratsubaNewton for all construction; NTT flag also applies to eligible construction products.
factors.how: Every arm builds full certified descriptor and full point base inside cold. Lookup additionally builds HashSet. Every NTT Arithmetic stage clears its per-field table cache; query repetitions each pay root/table setup.

comparisons.threshold: Describe complete cold ratio without DLP or fastest claim.

seed_derivation.note: Exact config JSON seed; source SplitMix draws alternate random-abscissa/canonical sqrt and indexed sums. Root splitting0x53555000+input index; certification42/representative3. Config IDs literal strings0..N-1. Written before calls; no seed relabeling.

instance_sampling.rule: [('word62', 'coset', 256), ('p224', 'coset', 128), ('p224', 'rational', 64)]; two retained independent deterministic targets/config, alternating random abscissa and conditioned sum, zero warmups. Calibration only, separate from future primary.

blinding.how: Explicit unblinded deterministic descriptive analysis frozen before data; no inferential selection or posthoc dispatch.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Separate calibration cyclic order; no primary inference.

power.note: Fixed two-input qualification/calibration only, one per population; no significance/power claim.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Conservative per-input planning cap from prior legacy observations; no new calibration result yet.

primary.name: Query primitive field multiplications
primary.definition: Existing evaluator query_work.muls includes inverse/sqrt internals. Shared backend constructor/precomputation timed inside cold but its primitive operations are unpriced; do not call fast cold counters complete.

primary.name: Complete ordered relations
primary.definition: Complete ordered pair array and SHA compared across all arms, then native BigUint scalar replay.

secondary.name: Local diagnostic cold/query elapsed intervals
secondary.definition: Cold begins before field construction/precomputation, curve/input encoding, certified descriptor/full point base/index and query; query separate. Profiler disabled. Local belowL2 diagnostics only, no admitted speedup.
secondary.resolution: monotonic Instant, actual host resolution recorded

stopping_rules.rule: 3 configs*9arms*2inputs=54 calls, no retries. Per-stage60s/4e9muls, worker135s, configuration300s, outer900s. Shared field setup inside outer/worker cold interval.
Wrong complete set or first positive failure stops; preserve failed/missing cells. Ordinary budget failures retained; later arms continue.

decision_rule.text: Qualification/calibration only. Future primary candidate already fixed NTT-half; no posthoc fastest-arm selection. Record all failures, descriptive subgroup native summaries, never pool populations.
decision_rule.statistic: Native per-row counts and descriptive paired summaries; never pool fields/representations/populations or selection with primary.
decision_rule.interval: Observed range, not a confidence interval.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Reference/candidate query and complete cold ratios; AA count1x/double2x; no p-values or exponent claim.

inadmissible: Pool populations/configurations/identities or calibration with main
Omit full construction or treat lookup setup as free
Promote diagnostic clocks to L2 or counters to wall speedup
Call Mobius-Kummer fixtures auxiliary-isogeny search costs
Self-sign general degree argument or claim complete formal tower instantiation
Paid/cloud experiments or local S3 operations
